body.summary: Add a pure completenessFindings(def) per kind returning at most two LOW DimensionFindings (missing narrative; elements missing a description) and call it from the code-review diagram handlers (er, sequence, component) and the ux dimension. Validators and firstCompanionValidationFailure stay unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Absent narrative -> one LOW; missing descriptions -> one LOW naming them; fully described -> [].
Code-review records show these LOWs and the verdict never becomes block because of them.
